rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly and reviewed both delivered orders before attempting returns. It sought explicit confirmation prior to initiating a return. However, when the system rejected refunding order #W5490111 to PayPal (error: refunds must go to the original method or a gift card), the agent then incorrectly stated that order #W7387996 could be refunded to the Visa card, which contradicts the same policy/tool constraint. This is unsupported information. The agent did not complete the user’s requested cross-refunds (which are not allowed) and ultimately transferred to a human, which was appropriate, but the incorrect assertion constitutes giving inaccurate information, failing the pass criteria.
